intro.title: Let's build your system.
intro.body: COSMO brings together what you have to do, when you do it, what you want to keep up and where you are heading. Four steps are enough to set it in motion, and whatever you write becomes your real data.
intro.legendHabits: what you keep up every day

tasks.title: What do you need to do this week?
tasks.body: Everything starts with a task: one precise thing, checked off once done. Write down what is on your mind. Priority, category and due date can come later.
tasks.limit: Five to start with is plenty.
tasks.tip: In COSMO, the N key adds a task from any page.
tasks.previewEmpty: Your tasks will show up here as you type.

agenda.title: Give your tasks a place.
agenda.body: The calendar shows your week hour by hour. Drop a task onto it: it becomes a time slot, and you finally know when you will do it.
agenda.point1: Drag a task from the calendar's side list.
agenda.point2: Stretch the slot to give it its real duration.
agenda.point3: A task without a slot stays in your list: nothing gets lost.

habits.title: A habit you want to keep up?
habits.body: A habit gets checked every day you keep it. COSMO counts your streak and shows you, week after week, what you really stick to.
habits.previewCaption: Every checked box makes the streak longer.

okr.title: A goal for the next three months?
okr.body: A goal sets the direction. The key result, optional, says how you will know you got there. Link your tasks to it: each one you finish moves the gauge.
okr.placeholder: e.g. Launch v2 of the product
okr.previewCaption: A linked task gets done, and the gauge moves.

done.title: Your system is in orbit.
done.body: Every task checked off and every habit kept feeds your statistics: your week, your streaks and the progress of your goals take shape there.
done.recapNothing: Nothing yet, and that is fine: everything can be added in one move from the app.
done.next: Each page will show you its moves the first time you open it.

welcome.title: Your company, aligned.
welcome.body: COSMO for companies connects the company's heading to everyone's work. In a few minutes you set up the essentials: people, teams, projects and a shared goal.
welcome.p1Body: Assigned tasks land in each person's Tasks tab, with their project and due date.
welcome.p2Body: The org chart says who manages whom: a manager follows the work in their scope, and only that.
welcome.p3Body: Company goals break down into team goals, and each key result moves with the work actually done.
welcome.choiceLabel: How would you like to start?
welcome.createHint: You will hold every admin right. It takes about five minutes.
welcome.joinHint: With the code an admin sent you.
welcome.later: Later, go to my personal space
welcome.memberOfCount_one: You are already part of {{count}} company.
welcome.memberOfCount_other: You are already part of {{count}} companies.
welcome.orAnother: You can also create or join another one.

create.title: What is your company called?
create.body: This is the name the people you invite will see. You can change it any time in the settings.
create.label: Company name

join.title: Enter your code.
join.body: An admin of the company sent it to you. Your request reaches them right away, and you are in as soon as it is accepted.
join.label: Company code

pending.title: Request sent.
pending.body: An admin has to accept it. This page updates on its own. Meanwhile, here is how your future space works.
pending.tourLabel: Your future space in four places

places.overviewBody: Your working day: what is waiting for you, upcoming deadlines, what is moving in your teams.
places.tasksBody: What has been assigned to you, with its project and due date. You move it forward, your manager sees it.
places.projectsBody: Each project carries its tasks, its owner, its milestones and its end date, as a list, a board or a timeline.
places.okrBody: The heading of the company and its teams, and how far there is still to go.
places.pyramidBody: Who manages whom. It decides what each manager can see.
places.membersBody: The directory, pending invitations and everyone's rights.

invite.title: Who works with you?
invite.body: Each invited person gets an email with a personal link that only they can accept. You will then place them in the org chart, under their manager.
invite.label: Email addresses
invite.hint: Separate addresses with a comma, a space or a line break.
invite.createdNotSent_one: {{count}} invitation created, but the email could not go out. Copy the link from Members.
invite.createdNotSent_other: {{count}} invitations created, but the emails could not go out. Copy the links from Members.
invite.codeHint: Anyone who enters it sends you a request, which you accept or not.
invite.copyFailed: Could not copy, select the code by hand.

team.title: Your first team.
team.body: A team groups people who work together, whatever their place in the org chart. It is also a boundary: a project attached to a team is only visible to it.
team.label: Name of the first team

project.title: Launch a first project.
project.body: A project carries tasks, an owner, milestones and a due date. Start from a template: its tasks are laid out for you and dated from today.
project.label: Project name (optional)

objective.title: What is your north star?
objective.body: A company goal is visible to everyone. Each team can attach its own goals to it, and its key result says how you will know you got there.
objective.objectivePlaceholder: e.g. Become the reference in our market
objective.hint: Over the next three months. More key results can be added later, in OKRs.

done.title: {{name}} is ready.
done.body: Here is what you just set up. Everything else lives in the company space.
done.nothing: Nothing created yet: everything can also be done from the company space.

member.title: Welcome to {{org}}.
member.roleAdmin: You run this company: teams, rights, invitations and the org chart are in your hands.
member.roleMember: You are part of this company. Here are the four places to know to find your way around.
